# Generated by tmuxy and rewritten on every launch: an edit here is lost.
# Your overrides go in tmuxy.conf in your config dir (~/.config/tmuxy);
# `tmuxy config paths` lists every file.

# Where the scripts and this file are, for the commands that name them.
set-environment -g TMUXY_DATA_DIR '/root/.local/share/tmuxy'
set-environment -g TMUXY_ENTRY_CONF '/root/.local/state/tmuxy/tmuxy.entry.conf'
set-option -g @tmuxy-cli '/root/.local/share/tmuxy/bin/tmuxy-cli'
set-environment -g TMUX_BIN 'tmux'
set-option -g @tmuxy-config-dir '/root/.config/tmuxy'
# The chain tmux is started with and every reload sources, in order.
source-file '/root/.local/share/tmuxy/tmuxy.essentials.conf'
source-file '/root/.local/share/tmuxy/tmuxy.defaults.conf'
# ~/.tmux.conf is not read: `tmuxy config use-tmux-conf on` sources it here.
source-file -q '/root/.config/tmuxy/tmuxy.conf'
source-file '/root/.local/share/tmuxy/tmuxy.essentials.conf'
